_comment: SAMPLE DATA — the 18-month WiSE roadmap. The dashboard draws six rolling fiscal quarters starting from the quarter containing today, so the timeline advances by itself. `rows` sets the order of swimlanes: 'wise' is the programme-wide lane, the rest are country ids from countries.json. Each initiative is a bar (start→end) or a milestone (start === end). Codex maintains `status`, `progress`, `progressNote`, `nextSteps`, `lastReviewed` and `reviewedBy` from sourced signals (meetings, Teams, email, roadmap docs) — it never invents dates: `start`/`end` changes need a sourced commitment. Humans add and remove initiatives (via the Add initiative issue) and always win on conflict.
